messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
So I woke up, opened my eyes, and immediately went back to sleep, where I found myself back at the mirror where my teeth had stopped falling out.

output.original_text: So I woke up, opened my eyes, and immediately went back to sleep, where I found myself back at the mirror where my teeth had stopped falling out.
output.joy: So I woke up, opened my eyes, and immediately went back to sleep, where I joyfully found myself back at the mirror where my teeth had stopped falling out!
output.sadness: So I woke up, opened my eyes, and immediately went back to sleep, where I sadly found myself back at the mirror where my teeth had stopped falling out, feeling lost in that moment.
output.fear: So I woke up, opened my eyes, and immediately went back to sleep, where I found myself back at the mirror, and I panicked when I realized my teeth had stopped falling out.
output.anger: So I woke up, opened my eyes, and immediately went back to sleep, where I ended up at the mirror, furious that my teeth had stopped falling out.
output.surprise: So I woke up, opened my eyes, and immediately went back to sleep, where I found myself back at the mirror, totally surprised that my teeth had stopped falling out!
output.disgust: So I woke up, opened my eyes, and immediately went back to sleep, where I found myself back at the mirror, utterly disgusted that my teeth had fallen out in the first place.
